note:
New gate, ADR-0062. A class body defines each member once.

The core package is at zero from the start: its one offender was
ir.ui.view._migrate_self_handled_arch, defined at line 454 and again at 3058,
and it is removed in the same change that adds this gate. Nothing else in
odoo/ shadows a member.

The rule had to learn one distinction before it could be floored here. An
@overload stub is not a definition -- the undecorated implementation that
follows the stubs is -- so reporting that implementation fired 13 times across
odoo/orm and odoo/libs (Field.__get__, Environment.ref, TraversalMixin.mapped,
LRU.pop and nine more), every one of them correct code. @property is NOT
exempted the same way: the legitimate redefinition is @x.setter, and a bare
`def` after a @property is the accident this exists to catch.
